limits: A current job can be traveling, waiting, interrupted or cancelled; it is not completion evidence.
Unknown citizen observations remain unknown, not zero activity.
Unseen activity between recorded boundaries is not measured.

scope: One saved-game continuation with unchanged model memory and conditions. New and cumulative results are separate. Current-job samples are not completed jobs; unknown costs are not zero. No ranking or sustainability conclusion. Private prompts, maps and native saves are excluded.
